job.title: Warehouse Operative
job.description:
We are currently recruiting for reliable and hardworking Warehouse Operatives to join a busy warehouse team based in Tamworth. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals looking for a warehouse role.

Shift Patterns:

We have the following shifts available:
Monday to Friday: 8:30am – 5:30pm
17:00-01:30 am
Tuesday to Sunday: 8:30am – 6:30pm
17:00-01:30 am

Key Responsibilities

  • Picking and packing customer orders accurately
  • Loading and unloading deliveries
  • Receiving and checking stock
  • Labelling and preparing goods for dispatch
  • Maintaining a clean, safe, and organised warehouse
  • Assisting with stock control and inventory checks
  • Following health and safety procedures at all times
  • Working efficiently as part of a team to meet daily targets

What We're Looking For

  • Previous warehouse experience is required
  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn
  • Good attention to detail
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Reliable, punctual, and hardworking
  • Good communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay of £12.80 per hour
  • Weekly pay
  • Supportive team environment
  • On-the-job training
  • Opportunities for career progression

Apply Today!

If you're looking for a warehouse role in Tamworth, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply now by submitting your CV, and a member of our recruitment team will be in touch to discuss the role.

Benefits:

  • Casual dress
  • Free parking
  • On-site parking
